title: Human Rights Day vigil near Phnom Penh Night Market
reason: Reported attendance is below 50: RFA reports 20 youth activists, while CamboJA says “more than a dozen.”
notes: The approximately 50 security personnel are not protesters and cannot be added to turnout. This is separate from the Freedom Park celebration and the Democracy Square activity.

title: “Thank Angkor” student parade
reason: The APSARA National Authority report describes a cultural/official celebration and student parade, without a demand directed to Cambodian government policy.
notes: The reported 1,200 students do not establish an anti-state protest.
